description.shortText: A bus-sized ambulance designed to assist with accidents involving a high number of injuries, offering a wide spectrum of emergency surgical interventions. It is an optimal solution for cities with dense populations that require constant medical support and assistance.

attachments.name: Large capacity intensive care ambulances on healthcare in europe
attachments.description: To optimise the use of available rescue personnel and improve the effectiveness of response to large scale disasters, the Dubai Government ordered three high-tech Large Capacity Intensive Care Ambulances from Germany.
